parts.text: SECOND VOICE An evening garden offers a gentle retreat from the bustle of the day, when cooler air settles softly among the leaves and the fading light casts everything in warm, golden tones. Sounds become more noticeable — birdsong quieting, crickets beginning their chorus — while fragrant flowers like jasmine and evening primrose release their subtle perfumes. It is a naturally peaceful time, inviting stillness and quiet reflection. GARDEN END
